sourceIssues.correction: Use general real points of D={u=0} on each of the arcs v/w<0 and v/w>0, avoiding zeros and poles of the unit parts of f0 and g0. Interpret sign constancy on punctured neighbourhoods and specialize only away from zeros and poles.
sourceIssues.reason: The printed fixed point is [0:−1:1:0], not the point transcribed in the inherited entry. sourceIssues.locator: Published §3.1 p.77; current author PDF page 15; arXiv v2 p.12
sourceIssues.correction: The fixed singular points over Sing R are where w vanishes, with v nonzero.
sourceIssues.reason: Over Sing R, r=0 and s is a unit, so rv^2=sw^2 forces w=0 and v≠0. The point v=0 would force both projective coordinates to vanish. The same word is in all three copies; the equation unambiguously determines the intended blow-up centre.

sourceIssues.locator: Published(5.5) p87, with the normalization fixed in §5.1 p86
sourceIssues.correction: No mandatory correction: choose the identification of the anti-invariant summand using zPrime=rv/(sqrt(a1)w), so its restriction to C is rg. With z=rv/w instead, the coefficient is sqrt(a1)rg.
sourceIssues.reason: The involution specifies an eigensummand, but does not fix its scalar identification with L^(-1)(-R). The source does not stipulate z=rv/w. Scaling the anti-invariant identification by 1/sqrt(a1) is permitted and gives the printed map (1,rg), with g unchanged. The inherited finding imposed an unstated normalization; either choice gives the same injectivity argument.
